name: flipUv not mirrored in the blocked cells
no bottom anchoring (quad centred on the root cell)
old: if (cz - visual / 2f < rootZ) cz = rootZ + visual / 2f;

name: anchoring uses the drawn side, not the visual size
old: if (cz - visual / 2f < rootZ) cz = rootZ + visual / 2f;
new: if (cz - drawSizeX * visual / 2f < rootZ) cz = rootZ + drawSizeX * visual / 2f;

name: blocked cells may leave the picture
old: if (cx < px0 || cx > px1 || cz < pz0 || cz > pz1) continue;

name: selection forgets the root cell
old: int minX = Math.Min(picture.MinX, rootX), minZ = Math.Min(picture.MinZ, rootZ);

name: picture box drops its last column
old:
int maxX = Math.Max(minX, (int)Math.Ceiling(x1) - 1), maxZ = Math.Max(minZ, (int)Math.Ceiling(z1) - 1);
            return new CellBox(minX, minZ, maxX, maxZ);
new:
int maxX = Math.Max(minX, (int)Math.Floor(x1) - 1), maxZ = Math.Max(minZ, (int)Math.Ceiling(z1) - 1);
            return new CellBox(minX, minZ, maxX, maxZ);

name: contact row rounded instead of floored
blocking scaled about the quad centre, not its bottom-centre
old: float left = q.CentreX - bs / 2f, bottom = q.MinZ;
new: float left = q.CentreX - bs / 2f, bottom = q.MinZ + (q.Size - bs) / 2f;

name: x jitter ignored by the blocking quad
picture box starts at the quad bottom (ignores V0)
contact column off by one (ceil instead of floor)
